title: VIXEN queued build requires repository-root cwd
body: The documented queued cmake build failed when invoked from the VIXEN subdirectory because build/wsl-debug was resolved relative to the wrong directory; the workable command required manually returning to the repository root. The build entrypoint should resolve its repo/build root or reject with the canonical invocation.

title: Editor local bake needs a declarative nested-recipe registry seam
body: To make the node-editor save/reopen and pack-recipe witness work, the editor had to manually cache pack RecipeEntry values and seed a local RecipeRegistry, and SVO bake APIs had to grow an explicit registry parameter for InvokeRecipe. This should be a single generated/declarative recipe-registration seam rather than hand-maintained editor cache and plumbing.

title: VIXEN full CTest treats targeted-build placeholders as failures
body: The final ctest sweep registered 470 entries but 215 missing or intentionally targeted-unbuilt executables as failing tests (names ending _NOT_BUILT or absent application binaries), obscuring the 189 runnable checks. The build/test contract should either build the complete registered set or exclude unresolved placeholders from the full sweep with an explicit status.

title: Generated AppFlow changes require an explicit dependent-test rebuild
body: After queued AppFlow regeneration/check passed, the first dependent blob witness still executed a stale test binary and failed only because it expected the old layer-{node} selector. The lane had to manually build target test_appflow_blob before the same CPU set could pass. Generated consumer/test dependencies should be rebuilt or invalidated automatically by the AppFlow check contract.
